scenes.title: A boat and a warning
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn agrees to row the party for two silver at first light, but refuses night trips. She says Saltmere Mine flooded with warm water the night the bell first rang forty years ago.

scenes.title: The hymn pages in Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black floodwater and hymn pages marked "M. Brand"; Teo identifies Mira's handwriting. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement, without confirmation; Oren takes two damage from the bad air.

scenes.title: The bell beneath the water
scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother. At midnight the bell rings twelve times, the humming grows louder, and pale figures appear beneath the water; the party leaves. The GM notes the choir clock at three of six.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.summary: The party plans to have Sela row them to the chapel at first light and dive at low tide; Vessa plans to buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest, returning to full health.
